rubriker.title: 2026 Fide World Chess Championship Game 1
World Championship Match: Sindarov v. Gukesh - Game 1 Live!
rubriker._rss_content: The 2026 World Chess Championship match takes place at the Fondation Martin Bodmer in Cologny, near Geneva, Switzerland. India's Gukesh Dommaraju is defending the title he won in Singapore two years ago against Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov, the winner of this year's Candidates Tournament. Both players are 20 years old at the start of the match, making it the youngest World Championship encounter in history. | Follow the action live starting at 15.00 CET (9.00 ET, 19.30 IST) | Photo: Michal Walusza

rubriker.title: Championnat du monde 2026Première partie du championnat du monde 2026 Sindarov-Gukesh
Match por el Campeonato del Mundo - Sindarov vs. Gukesh: Partida 1
rubriker._rss_content: El match por el Campeonato Mundial de Ajedrez se disputa en la Fundación Martin Bodmer, en Cologny, cerca de Ginebra (Suiza). El indio Gukesh Dommaraju defiende el título que conquistó hace dos años en Singapur ante el uzbeko Javokhir Sindarov, ganador del Torneo de Candidatos de este año. Ambos jugadores tienen 20 años al inicio del encuentro, por lo que se trata del duelo por el título mundial con los protagonistas más jóvenes de la historia. | Sigue las partidas en directo a partir de las 15:00 hora de Madrid (11:00 Buenos Aires, 9:30 IST) | Foto: Michal Walusza

rubriker.title: Lagno Wins 2026 Wr Womens Chess Tour Grand Final
Kateryna Lagno wins inaugural WR Women's Chess Tour
rubriker._rss_content: Kateryna Lagno claimed the winner's trophy at the inaugural WR Women's Chess Tour 2026. She reached the final in both the rapid and the blitz section of the final tournament in Stuttgart but lost on both occasions. Nevertheless, her results were enough to secure overall victory in the inaugural tour organised by Wadim Rosenstein. Anna Muzychuk won the blitz tournament, while Carissa Yip came out on top in the rapid event. | Pictured: (from left to right): blitz winner Anna Muzychuk, overall winner Kateryna Lagno and rapid winner Carissa Yip | Photo: Lennart Ootes

rubriker.title: Azmaiparashvili suspects Russian bid to take over European chess behind €4m ECU offer
rubriker._rss_content: The European Chess Union President says Russia is "trying to take over Europe" through sport. He suspects a €4 million sponsorship that FIDE President Timur Turlov has tied to a change of ECU leadership is part of that effort.

rubriker.title: World Championship matches: Highlights from 140 years of history
rubriker._rss_content: World Championship matches make chess history. Some games are remembered for their beauty, others for dramatic twists, spectacular blunders or their historical significance. rubriker.title: Gukesh y Sindarov comparten sus impresiones ante los medios
rubriker._rss_content: El 22 de noviembre se dio inicio oficialmente al Campeonato Mundial de Ajedrez FIDE 2026, patrocinado por Salesforce. Los periodistas presentes tuvieron la oportunidad de participar en dos sesiones de prensa por separado con Gukesh Dommaraju y Javokhir Sindarov, quienes compartieron detalles sobre su preparación, sus expectativas y sus impresiones de cara al esperado duelo.
